title: Web QA audit results
description: One deterministic acceptance-check result for each audited public page.

requestedUrl.title: Requested URL
requestedUrl.description: The public page URL submitted for auditing.

finalUrl.title: Final URL
finalUrl.description: The URL reached after safe redirect handling.

auditedAt.title: Audited at
auditedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the audit began.

acceptanceThreshold.title: Passing score
acceptanceThreshold.description: Minimum score required for this run to pass.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the page returned a successful HTTP response and met the passing score.

http.title: HTTP result
http.description: Final response status, success flag, and content type.

metadata.title: Page metadata
metadata.description: Title, description, canonical URL, and viewport metadata.

counts.title: Element counts
counts.description: Counts of headings, images, forms, and links.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Actionable QA findings ordered by detection sequence.

linkChecks.title: Link checks
linkChecks.description: Results of bounded same-origin link checks.

error.title: Error
error.description: A safe error message when a requested page could not be audited.

overview.title: Acceptance results
overview.description: The decision and evidence fields most useful before delivery.
